title: A Threshold Is Not a Count

scenes.visual: Title card: A Threshold Is Not a Count.

scenes.tts: A mouse passes its hearing test after loud noise. Can its cochlea still be damaged?
scenes.visual: A mouse beside a loudspeaker, with a tick mark over a hearing test chart and a question mark over the cochlea.
scenes.narration: A mouse passes its hearing test after loud noise. Can its cochlea still be damaged?

scenes.tts: A threshold is the quietest sound that evokes a response. That is what a hearing test measures.
scenes.visual: A rising tone bar with a marker at the faintest level that produces a response trace. Label: threshold.
scenes.narration: A threshold is the quietest sound that evokes a response. That is what a hearing test measures.

scenes.tts: Inner hair cells pass sound to nerve fibres at ribbon synapses. The ribbon holds a ready supply of vesicles.
scenes.visual: One inner hair cell with gold ribbons along its base, vesicles clustered at each ribbon, nerve fibres below.
scenes.narration: Inner hair cells pass sound to nerve fibres at ribbon synapses. The ribbon holds a ready supply of vesicles.

scenes.tts: Kujawa and Liberman exposed male mice of one lab strain, sixteen weeks old. The loud noise lasted two hours.
scenes.visual: A mouse in a clear chamber beside a speaker. On screen: Kujawa and Liberman, 2009; male CBA/CaJ mice, 16 weeks; 8 to 16 kHz octave-band noise, 100 dB SPL, 2 hours.
scenes.narration: Kujawa and Liberman exposed male mice of one lab strain, sixteen weeks old. The loud noise lasted two hours.

scenes.tts: Thresholds rose after the noise, then returned to their pre-exposure values by two weeks. The hair cells remained intact.
scenes.visual: A threshold curve drawn three times: before noise, raised after the noise, back on the baseline at two weeks. Hair cells drawn whole.
scenes.narration: Thresholds rose after the noise, then returned to their pre-exposure values by two weeks. The hair cells remained intact.

scenes.tts: Eight weeks later, what would you predict for the number of ribbon synapses?
scenes.visual: The same hair cell, its base hidden behind a question mark card. Label: 32 kHz place, 8 weeks.
scenes.narration: Eight weeks later, what would you predict for the number of ribbon synapses?

scenes.visual: Hold on the question card.

scenes.tts: About half were gone at the thirty-two kilohertz place. Nerve terminals had been lost early.
scenes.caption: About half were gone at the 32 kHz place. Nerve terminals had been lost early.
scenes.visual: The card lifts: half the gold ribbons are now empty outlines, and some nerve terminals are dashed circles.
scenes.narration: About half were gone at the 32 kHz place. Nerve terminals had been lost early.

scenes.tts: Losing these synapses while the hair cells survive is called cochlear synaptopathy.
scenes.visual: The damaged synapse view with the term written beside it. Label: cochlear synaptopathy.
scenes.narration: Losing these synapses while the hair cells survive is called cochlear synaptopathy.

scenes.tts: Why would losing half the synapses leave the threshold where it was?
scenes.visual: Side by side: half the ribbons missing, and a threshold curve that has not moved.
scenes.narration: Why would losing half the synapses leave the threshold where it was?

scenes.tts: Nerve fibres at one place differ in sensitivity. Some respond to very quiet sounds, others need louder sound.
scenes.visual: Sixteen fibres in a row, each with its own small threshold marker, spread along a loudness axis.
scenes.narration: Nerve fibres at one place differ in sensitivity. Some respond to very quiet sounds, others need louder sound.

scenes.tts: A threshold asks when the response to a quiet sound first stands out from background firing.
scenes.visual: A shaded band of background firing across the sixteen fibres. A quiet tone arrives and only the two most sensitive fibres rise above the band.
scenes.narration: A threshold asks when the response to a quiet sound first stands out from background firing.

scenes.tts: At the quietest levels, only the most sensitive fibres do that.
scenes.visual: Hold on the two fibres above the background band; the rest stay inside it.
scenes.narration: At the quietest levels, only the most sensitive fibres do that.

scenes.tts: Here is a small model of sixteen fibres. It is illustrative and passive, not fitted to mouse data.
scenes.visual: The sixteen-fibre population with a caption: illustrative model, not mouse data.
scenes.narration: Here is a small model of sixteen fibres. It is illustrative and passive, not fitted to mouse data.

scenes.tts: Remove half the fibres at random, or remove the most sensitive half. Which moves the threshold?
scenes.visual: Two copies of the population, one with a random half greyed out, one with the most sensitive half greyed out.
scenes.narration: Remove half the fibres at random, or remove the most sensitive half. Which moves the threshold?

scenes.visual: Hold on the two populations.

scenes.tts: Losing a random half moved the threshold by about two decibels. A hearing test moves in five decibel steps.
scenes.caption: Losing a random half moved the threshold by about 2 dB. A hearing test moves in 5 dB steps.
scenes.visual: On screen: random half, +2 dB. A five decibel step ruler beside it.
scenes.narration: Losing a random half moved the threshold by about 2 dB. A hearing test moves in 5 dB steps.

scenes.tts: Losing the most sensitive half moved it by about eight decibels. That is more than one five decibel step.
scenes.caption: Losing the most sensitive half moved it by about 8 dB. That is more than one 5 dB step.
scenes.visual: On screen: most sensitive half, +8 dB, more than one 5 dB step.
scenes.narration: Losing the most sensitive half moved it by about 8 dB. That is more than one 5 dB step.

scenes.tts: In this model, the sound-driven response to a loud sound halved in every case.
scenes.visual: A loud tone arrives; the summed glow from the population is half as bright in each damaged version. On screen: sound-driven response, 0.50 of intact (model).
scenes.narration: In this model, the sound-driven response to a loud sound halved in every case.

scenes.tts: So here is the one idea. Hearing runs through a chain: hair cell, ribbon synapse, nerve fibre.
scenes.visual: Three links drawn as a chain: hair cell, ribbon synapse, nerve fibre.
scenes.narration: So here is the one idea. Hearing runs through a chain: hair cell, ribbon synapse, nerve fibre.

scenes.tts: A threshold depends mostly on the most sensitive links. It does not count the links.
scenes.visual: A quiet tone lighting only the most sensitive link, with a counter beside the chain crossed out.
scenes.narration: A threshold depends mostly on the most sensitive links. It does not count the links.

scenes.tts: In these mice, a cochlea lost many synapses and still passed a hearing test.
scenes.visual: The damaged cell beside a normal hearing test chart with a tick.
scenes.narration: In these mice, a cochlea lost many synapses and still passed a hearing test.

scenes.tts: And a repair has to put back what is missing: a molecule in a surviving cell, or the cell itself.
scenes.visual: Two chains: one with a dim middle link inside intact cells, one with the whole hair cell missing.
scenes.narration: And a repair has to put back what is missing: a molecule in a surviving cell, or the cell itself.

scenes.tts: In people, temporal bones show nerve fibre loss after death. No one can count synapses in a living ear.
scenes.visual: A skull section with fibres counted under a microscope, beside a living ear with a question mark. On screen: 52 cochleas, Wu and colleagues, 2021.
scenes.narration: In people, temporal bones show nerve fibre loss after death. No one can count synapses in a living ear.

scenes.tts: Living ears give only indirect signals, and the evidence from them is mixed.
scenes.visual: Two study cards side by side, one showing a raised ratio and one showing no difference, both stamped indirect.
scenes.narration: Living ears give only indirect signals, and the evidence from them is mixed.

scenes.tts: A normal threshold is good news about sensitivity. It is not a census of synapses.
scenes.visual: Final card: the chain of three links beside a hearing test chart marked normal.
scenes.narration: A normal threshold is good news about sensitivity. It is not a census of synapses.

scenes.visual: End card: A Threshold Is Not a Count.
